title: Every part on a canned line is priced by a tier work order's tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new canned line for this test with labor of 1.00 hour and a special-order part in category A, cost $100.00, saved price $150.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Add the canned line to work order 1.
  3. Click the Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The canned line's part reads $121.50 ($135.00 × 0.90 = $121.50), not its saved $150.00.
  • The canned line's labor is the canned line's own labor amount.

Step 3:

  • Priced by names tier A for the canned line's part.
